modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and loads database path and readonly configuration from an environment mapping.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Defines the Order dataclass used as the in-memory domain representation.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: Provides OrderRepository, which creates the SQLite orders table and reads or inserts orders.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds order audit-event dictionaries; it does not persist them.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Implements create and read order request handlers, including payload mapping and response shaping.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Registers POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> callbacks on an application adapter.

modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: Bootstraps settings and the repository, initializes the schema, and prints readiness.

key_functions.description: Reads MINISVC_DB, defaulting to orders.sqlite, and parses MINISVC_READONLY as true only when its value is 1.
Loads environment settings, constructs OrderRepository, initializes SQLite schema, prints readiness, and returns 0.
Stores the configured database path as a pathlib.Path.
Opens SQLite and creates orders(order_id, customer, total_cents) if absent.
Performs one parameterized insert into orders; there is no retry or readonly check.
Performs a parameterized lookup and reconstructs an Order, or returns None.
Maps POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> to handler callbacks.
Indexes required payload keys, converts total_cents with int(), saves the Order, and returns a created response with a generated event dictionary.
Reads by order ID and returns either missing or an order response with a read event.
Creates an in-memory order event containing type, action, order_id, and total_cents; it has no database side effect.
Dataclass with order_id, customer, and total_cents fields.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: Console script minisvc resolves to minisvc.cli:main.
load_settings selects MINISVC_DB or orders.sqlite and records the MINISVC_READONLY flag.
main instantiates OrderRepository with the selected path.
main calls OrderRepository.init_schema, creating the SQLite orders table if needed.
main prints minisvc ready at <database path> and returns 0.

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: register_routes wires POST /orders to a lambda that calls create_order(payload, repo).
create_order reads order_id, customer, and total_cents from the payload and converts total_cents with int().
create_order instantiates Order and calls repo.save(order).
OrderRepository.save inserts the order into SQLite using parameterized SQL.
create_order builds an in-memory created event with order_event and returns the response dictionary.
